title: Normalized open-normal-kernel invariant comparison data
statement: On the coherent profinite site with the size convention [def-weil-size-convention], let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring], written using the bundled commutative ring interface of [def-sfb-condensed-equivariant-bar-data]. Use the actual internal action categories $\mathcal A_P(A)$ and normalized full-invariant data of [def-sfb-condensed-action-module], and the K-injective total derived functors of [sk-def-sfb-derived-categories]. Define the categorical certificate to consist of Grothendieck abelian structures on these fixed preadditive action categories and derived localizations in the recorded universes. For profinite $G,L$ and open normal $K$ in $G$, use the actual subgroup $K$, quotient $Q=G/K$, projection $G\times L\to Q\times L$, and inclusion $k\mapsto(k,1)$. A normalized quotient datum consists of an additive functor $T:\mathcal A_{G\times L}(A)\to\mathcal A_{Q\times L}(A)$ preserving K-injectives, a sectionwise injective inclusion into the underlying original module with image the sections fixed by every kernel-valued generalized element after every profinite base change, the residual quotient action induced by lifts, and the adjunction from quotient inflation to $T$, with transpose given by restriction to invariants and inverse transpose by the inclusion. A comparison datum additionally consists of the identity of exact left inflations and the ordinary identities $\Gamma_{G\times L}\simeq\Gamma_{Q\times L}\circ T$ and $UT\simeq\Gamma_K\circ\operatorname{Res}_K$, each normalized by the invariant inclusion. A normalized system supplies these data for all the indicated rings and profinite groups. A full-invariant family supplies the recorded normalized invariant functor for every profinite group, together with certificates that forgetting, arbitrary continuous restriction of profinite actions and trivial inflation are additive and preserve finite limits and finite colimits. Define the kernel K-injective preservation certificate separately; they do not assert their own existence. From these data define the canonical descent of the exact left-inflation identity as the inverse derived-composition identification followed by the derived image of that identity; define the canonical derived composition comparison $c$, the kernel comparison $\beta$ when kernel restriction preserves K-injectives, the canonical resolution unit $\eta_X:Q(TX)\to RT(QX)$ for an unbounded complex $X$, and $\operatorname{inf}_X=c_X^{-1}\circ R\Gamma_Q(\eta_X)$. Define their unit and resolution-normalization predicates by the displayed canonical exact-functor identifications and by the equality on any K-injective resolutions $i:X\to I$, $a:TX\to J$ and any lift $b:J\to TI$ satisfying $ba\simeq T(i)$, using the actual invariant-complex map of $b$.
